_comment: Every customizable option, defined once. The admin option rows, the free version's locked rows, and the preview JavaScript are all generated from this file. Options marked common are offered by every style; the rest are listed per style in catalog.json. Order here is the order they appear in the admin. 'group' decides which panel a row lands in: behavior, physics (the collapsed Advanced Physics group inside Behavior) or appearance. Numeric options get a slider unless slider is false, and the slider needs min and max.

scalar.label: Size
scalar.description: How big each piece is. 1 is normal size. Try a small number — teeny tiny confetti is adorable.

overlay.label: Overlay Message
overlay.description: Cover the screen with a message while the confetti runs.

show_once.label: Show Once
show_once.checkbox_label: Only show this confetti one time per visitor
show_once.description: Uses browser storage to remember whether it already ran.

duration.label: Duration
duration.description: How long this style keeps going.

delay.label: Delay
delay.description: How long to wait before the confetti starts.

speed.label: Speed
speed.description: How fast the style plays, 1 to 100.

particleCount.label: Particle Count
particleCount.description: How many pieces to launch. More is fun — but there is a lot of math involved.

spread.label: Spread
spread.description: How far off the launch angle pieces can go, in degrees.

startVelocity.label: Start Velocity
startVelocity.description: How fast the pieces are moving when they launch, in pixels.

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.description: How hard the pieces are pulled down. 1 is normal, 0.5 is half. Go below 0 and they float up.

decay.label: Decay
decay.description: How quickly the pieces lose speed. Keep this between 0 and 1, or they speed up instead.

drift.label: Drift
drift.description: How much the pieces slide sideways as they fall. Negative goes left, positive goes right.

ticks.label: Ticks
ticks.description: How many times each piece moves before it disappears. Raise it if they vanish too soon.

flat.label: Flat
flat.checkbox_label: Turn off the 3D tilt and wobble
flat.description: Flat pieces look a little sad, but emojis and SVGs are much easier to see.

zindex.label: Z-Index
zindex.description: How far in front of the page the confetti sits. Defaults to the highest value a browser accepts, so it lands on top of popups and cookie banners. Lower it if you want something else to cover the confetti.
